name: Chalong
seoTitle: Chalong, Phuket: Area Guide, Rents & Property
seoDescription: Chalong, Phuket: a central residential area with Wat Chalong, Chalong Pier and good-value homes. Area guide, typical rents, rental market, FAQ and calculator.
intro: Chalong is a central residential area in the south of Phuket, home to Wat Chalong, the island's most important temple, and Chalong Pier, the departure point for many island trips. It offers good-value houses and condos with easy access to Rawai, Kata and Phuket Town.
overview:
Chalong lies inland of Chalong Bay, between Rawai, Kata and Phuket Town, around the Chalong roundabout. It is mainly residential, with housing estates, villas with gardens, condominiums and local businesses.
The bay itself is a working harbour with Chalong Pier rather than a swimming beach; residents drive to Rawai, Nai Harn or Kata for the beach.
suitableFor: Families who want space at a good price
People training at local Muay Thai and fitness camps
highlights: Wat Chalong and the Big Buddha viewpoint nearby
Chalong Pier for boat and dive trips
Large supermarkets, gyms and Muay Thai camps
Central for Rawai, Kata and Phuket Town

lifestyle: Chalong has big supermarkets, international and local restaurants, gyms and some of Phuket's best-known Muay Thai camps. It is practical for everyday life and less touristy than the beach towns, with quick access to the south-coast beaches and Phuket Town.
beaches: Chalong Bay is used by boats and the pier, so it is not a swimming beach. Rawai, Nai Harn and Kata beaches are typically 10 to 20 minutes away by car.
rentalMarket: Chalong is a long-term rental market. Demand comes from families, long-stay residents, people working in the south of the island and those training at fitness and Muay Thai camps. Holiday demand is limited because there is no swimming beach.

rentalDetails.title: Long-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Houses and villas with gardens are popular with families; condos with people training or working locally.

rentalDetails.title: Short-term rentals
rentalDetails.text: Mostly fitness and Muay Thai visitors on monthly stays; little classic beach-holiday demand.

rentalDetails.title: Suitable property types
rentalDetails.text: Houses and pool villas with gardens; practical condos.

rentalDetails.title: Advantages and limitations
rentalDetails.text: Advantage: value for money and a central location. Limitations: no swimming beach and traffic around the Chalong roundabout.

investment: Chalong attracts buyers looking for value and long-term rental demand rather than beach-front holiday letting. Houses and villas on quieter side roads suit family tenants.

investmentDetails.title: Risks to consider
investmentDetails.text: Lower holiday demand; many similar housing estates compete for tenants.

investmentDetails.title: Ownership costs
investmentDetails.text: Maintenance, garden and pool care, insurance and periods between tenants.

faq.question: Is there a beach in Chalong?
faq.answer: Chalong Bay is used by boats and the pier and is not a swimming beach. Rawai, Nai Harn and Kata beaches are about 10 to 20 minutes away by car.

faq.question: Is Chalong a good place to live in Phuket?
faq.answer: Chalong suits people who want a practical, central base with supermarkets, gyms and schools nearby, and good value compared with the beach areas.

faq.question: What is Chalong Pier used for?
faq.answer: Chalong Pier is the main departure point for boat and dive trips to the islands south of Phuket.

faq.question: Can I buy property in Chalong?
faq.answer: Yes. Our catalogue currently lists projects on the edge of Chalong rather than in it, such as Aura Condominium and Botanica Grand Sea Through in neighbouring Rawai. Ask us about resale condos, houses and villas in Chalong itself.

faq.question: Is Chalong good for families?
faq.answer: Yes, many families choose Chalong for houses with gardens at lower prices than the beach areas, with schools and shops nearby.
